Package org.apache.juneau.terminal.report

Class TerminalEvent

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.terminal.report.TerminalEvent
public final class TerminalEvent extends Object
One event of a terminal-view stream.

An immutable value with static factories, one per event kind. Every factory and with* method validates its argument against the event contract and throws IllegalArgumentException naming the member, so a producer finds its bug where it is written. toContractMap() produces the wire form, and fromMap(Map) is its strict inverse.

A seq() of 0 means the event has not been numbered yet; sources assign it.

    • withRawOffset

      public TerminalEvent withRawOffset(long offset)
      Sets the raw byte offset of a step, suite or test event.

      The 0-based offset into the raw output log of the start of the line that produced the event; a terminal view scrolls to it.

      Parameters:
      offset - The offset, 0 to 9007199254740991.
      Returns:
      A copy with the member set.

    • toContractMap

      public Map<String,Object> toContractMap()
      Returns the event in its wire form.

      The map is ordered (ev, seq when assigned, then the members in contract order) and omits unset optional members. A fresh map is returned on every call.

      Returns:
      The wire map.

    • fromMap

      public static TerminalEvent fromMap(Map<?,?> map)
      Builds an event from its wire form.

      The strict inverse of toContractMap(). Unknown members are ignored; an unknown ev or a malformed known member throws.

      Parameters:
      map - The wire map.
      Returns:
      A new event.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the map is not a valid event.
